columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: This field represents user guid or user session for which data is being cached.

columns.name: PRIVILEGE
columns.description: This field represents user's privilege based on which data is being cached in this table.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: This field represents an internal ID for the assignment to which user has access to.

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: This field represents last time when cache was refreshed.
